stories.headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just crossed 1 billion monthly users
stories.blurb: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced Gemini hit a billion monthly users, making it Google's fastest-growing product ever. OpenAI's ChatGPT reached the same milestone around the same time. Both apps went from zero to a billion users in roughly two years—faster than any consumer product in history.
stories.why_it_matters: AI chatbots are now as mainstream as search engines and social networks.
stories.original_headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users

stories.headline: xAI co-founder's 2-month-old startup just raised $1.1 billion
stories.blurb: River AI, founded by Igor Babuschkin who helped start xAI, closed a $1.1 billion Series A led by General Catalyst after just two months. The company is building personal AI agents, though details on what makes their approach different remain sparse.
stories.why_it_matters: VCs are writing billion-dollar checks for agent startups based on founder pedigree alone
stories.original_headline: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI

stories.headline: AI coding startup Lovable raises $400M at $13.3B valuation
stories.blurb: Swedish startup Lovable just closed a $400 million round at a $13.3 billion valuation, putting it in the same funding league as Anthropic and positioning it to compete directly with established AI coding tools. The company builds AI agents that write production code.
stories.why_it_matters: A coding-focused startup hitting unicorn status this fast signals investors expect AI coding to be a massive standalone category.
stories.original_headline: AI Coding Startup Lovable Raises $400 Million at $13.3 Billion Valuation

stories.headline: Claude will now invisibly watermark every AI-generated text and image
stories.blurb: Anthropic is embedding machine-readable watermarks in Claude's text outputs and cryptographically signed metadata in images to comply with EU transparency rules. The markers are invisible to humans but detectable by software—meaning every Claude response and generated file will carry proof of its AI origin.
stories.why_it_matters: First major model to watermark text at scale, setting a precedent other labs may follow.
stories.original_headline: Claude will apply invisible watermarks to AI text and images

stories.headline: NVIDIA's new open model runs AI agents cheaper and longer
stories.blurb: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is built specifically for long-running agents that need to stay active without burning through compute. NVIDIA also released NeMo Switchyard, a router that picks the cheapest capable model for each task—so your agent can use a small model for simple calls and switch to bigger ones only when needed.
stories.why_it_matters: Agentic workflows get expensive fast; this makes them viable at scale.
stories.original_headline: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard Deliver Faster, Smarter, More Efficient Agentic AI

stories.headline: ChatGPT finally gets a native Linux desktop app
stories.blurb: OpenAI just released a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app for Linux, closing the gap after launching Mac and Windows versions earlier. Linux users can now access ChatGPT directly from their desktop without needing a browser tab open.
stories.why_it_matters: Linux developers no longer need workarounds to use ChatGPT as a desktop tool.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
